dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: Children have all sorts of wonderful dreams, with more colors than even the feathers of the Dusk Bird.

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: But once they grow up, their once-vibrant dreams slowly begin to fade.

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: Luckily, we can use the written word to make a record of our dreams before they disappear. Maybe, when it comes down to it, that's what fairytales are.
